name: animated-dropdown-menu
title: Animated Dropdown Menu
description: A menu of actions or options that opens from a button.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette, menu included. The highlighted item and the selection pill take its primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: animation
props.label: Animation
props.description: How the menu opens: collapse, slide, scale, reveal or morph.

props.name: exitFast
props.label: Exit fast
props.description: The menu closes faster than it opens.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the open animation takes, in seconds.

props.name: delay
props.label: Delay
props.description: Wait before the menu starts opening, in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Delay between each item appearing, in seconds.

props.name: itemHighlight
props.label: Item highlight
props.description: How the highlight moves between items: slides, fills from the top, or none.

props.name: selectionIndicator
props.label: Selection indicator
props.description: Mark shown on the chosen item: check, dot or bar.

props.name: showDescriptions
props.label: Descriptions
props.description: Shows a short description under each item.

props.name: rollingText
props.label: Rolling text
props.description: Item labels roll to a second copy on hover.

props.name: icon
props.label: Icon
props.description: Icon on the trigger: plus that turns to minus, or a chevron.

props.name: rollingValue
props.label: Rolling value
props.description: The chosen value in the trigger rolls to the new one when it changes.

props.name: openOnHover
props.label: Open on hover
props.description: Opens the menu when you hover the trigger, not only on click.

props.name: closeDelayOnSelect
props.label: Close delay on select
props.description: Waits a moment after a pick so you see the selection before the menu closes.

props.name: typeahead
props.label: Type to jump
props.description: With the menu open, typing a letter moves the highlight to the first item starting with it (P jumps to Paused). Off: letter keys do nothing.
